stops.name: parco regionale della Vena del Gesso Romagnola
stops.detail: The Vena del Gesso Romagnola Regional Park, located in the Romagna hinterland between Imola and Faenza, is a protected natural area of over two thousand hectares that stands out in the northern Apennines as the only mountain range constituted almost exclusively by plaster. The peculiarities and reasons of interest of this territory have led, in the 1960s, to the idea of protecting the area, starting studies to define and circumscribe the area. The park was established on 15 February [dated source] by the Emilia-Romagna Region.
